VERDICT: LGTM

The change slots cleanly into an already-established pattern. The mapper already derives three read-only DTO fields (`displayName`, `initials`, `locality`), each as an `@Mapping(... expression = "java(toX(owner))")` line paired with a `default` helper method carrying Javadoc in a consistent style. `contactPreference` is added in exactly the same way: one mapping line in the same block, one `toContactPreference` default helper right after `toLocality`, with matching Javadoc phrasing ("Derive the owner's read-only ..."). The return type `OwnerDto.ContactPreferenceEnum` keeps the derivation co-located with the other presentation-derived fields, which is the natural home for it. The mapper isn't becoming a catch-all — it remains a cohesive set of Owner↔OwnerDto mappings and their derivations. The OpenAPI `contactPreference` schema addition mirrors the surrounding read-only enum/string properties. No duplication, logic is in the right unit.
